art_01.title: How do I cancel a reservation and receive a refund in Algeria?
art_01.snippet: Cancellation policies vary between Flexible, Moderate and Strict.
art_01.content: You can cancel your reservation directly from your Trips page. Stays with the Flexible policy allow a full refund (excluding minor processing fees) if cancelled up to 48 hours before check-in. Refunds to Algerian CIB and Edahabia cards are processed within 3 to 5 business days back to your issuing bank.

art_02.title: Which Algerian payment methods does DARNA support?
art_02.snippet: DARNA supports SATIM interbank CIB cards, Algérie Poste Edahabia and international cards.
art_02.content: DARNA supports national Algerian payment cards through the SATIM interbank gateway: CIB debit cards from all Algerian public and private banks (BNA, BEA, CPA, BDL, BADR, Gulf Bank, Natixis, Société Générale) and Algérie Poste Edahabia cards. Diaspora and international travelers can also pay with Visa and Mastercard in euros or US dollars.

art_03.title: How does identity verification work for Algerian travelers?
art_03.snippet: Verification protects hosts and travelers through Algerian biometric ID.
art_03.content: To foster safety and mutual trust, hosts may require government ID verification. You can upload a photo of your Algerian biometric national ID card (CNIBE) or your Algerian passport. Our automated verification checks security holograms and encrypts your document under strict privacy standards.

art_04.title: Are desert 4x4 tours and Sahara expeditions led by certified local guides?
art_04.snippet: All Sahara expeditions work with certified local Tuareg or desert guides.
art_04.content: Yes. In destinations like Djanet (Tassili n'Ajjer), Tamanrasset (Hoggar) and Taghit (Grand Erg Occidental), all licensed experiences and 4x4 rentals with drivers operate under Algerian tourism safety guidelines and national park regulations.

art_05.title: How do I list my villa, apartment or rental car on DARNA?
art_05.snippet: Become a host in 10 minutes with instant wilaya location mapping.
art_05.content: Select “Become a host” at the top of any page to open the listing creator. Choose your listing type (home, vehicle or experience), set your wilaya and city, upload high-resolution photos, set your nightly price in Algerian dinars (DZD) and publish. Your listing becomes discoverable across Algeria and worldwide right away.

art_06.title: Can I book vehicle rentals and airport pickups with DARNA?
art_06.snippet: DARNA offers SUVs, sedans and desert-ready 4x4s from verified hosts.
art_06.content: Yes! DARNA offers vehicle rentals from verified agencies and individual hosts at Algiers Houari Boumediene Airport, Oran Ahmed Ben Bella Airport, Constantine and the southern gateway hubs. You can choose unlimited mileage, airport delivery or a driver at checkout.
